name: 53075 · Random Lake, WI
findings: ZIP 53075 (Random Lake) has 18 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 7 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 53075 (Random Lake) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 53075 (Random Lake) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).
